extensionDescription.message: Add senders to filters, share complete filters across accounts, and create tags in Thunderbird’s filter editor.

filterNewTagTooltip.message: Create a tag and select it for this filter action

filterTagCreateError.message: Could not create the tag. Please try again.

filterTagSelectError.message: The tag was created, but could not be selected. Reopen the filter editor and select it from the tag list.

rowExternalMessage.message: Select a message stored in an account folder

rowLoadError.message: Could not load filters; try opening the menu again

notifyIneligible.message: ‘$1’ cannot be updated: $2. Use Manage filters to edit it.

notifyNotFound.message: ‘$1’ is no longer available. Open the menu again.

notifyError.message: Sender to Filter could not complete the action: $1

notifySharedBlocked.message: No filters changed. Open Manage shared filters to review the affected accounts.

notifySharedResult.message: Added $1, already present $2, to ‘$3’; $4 of $5 accounts are up to date. Open Manage shared filters for details.

sharedIntro.message: Keep complete message filters consistent across the accounts you choose.

sharedDraftHelp.message: The Thunderbird editor changes a draft. Review the account preview and save here to update linked filters.

sharedPlacementHelp.message: Existing copies keep their positions. Earlier account filters can affect which messages reach this rule; other filters are never rearranged.

sharedSameFolders.message: Use the first selected account’s destinations for all selected accounts

sharedPreviewHelp.message: Check every account, folder and position. Saving updates future filtering; it does not run filters on existing messages.

sharedFooter.message: Sharing works within this Thunderbird profile. Disabling the add-on leaves each account’s last saved filter in place.

sharedEmptyHelp.message: Start with an existing filter, select the accounts that should use it, and choose a destination for each account.

sharedReviewMappings.message: Choose and review every destination before saving this draft.

sharedForgetConfirm.message: Remove this unavailable or missing copy from sharing? Its native file will not be changed. A returning account may retain an unlinked copy. Account: $1

sharedChooseSource.message: Choose an available, unlinked source filter.

sharedNativeTooltip.message: Linked shared-filter copy. Check Manage shared filters for synchronization status and edit the shared rule there. Use the shared-account checkbox below to choose where it runs.

sharedNativeReviewTooltip.message: This filter has an unrecognized shared link. Review it in Manage shared filters before running it across accounts.

sharedNativeRunAcross.message: Run shared filters across all linked accounts (Inboxes)

sharedNativeAutomaticHelp.message: Checked filters run automatically at their configured times. Highlight rows to choose filters for Run selected filters.

sharedNativeRunSelectedHelp.message: Run only the highlighted rows, including filters whose automatic checkbox is unchecked.

sharedNativeRunAllHelp.message: Run all filters checked under Run automatically in this account, including filters hidden by search. The shared-account option below applies to both run buttons.

sharedNativeRunAcrossHelp.message: Applies to both run buttons. Checked: shared filters run on the Inbox in each linked account; other filters use the chosen folder. Unchecked: all filters use only the chosen folder.

sharedNativeRunAllPreview.message: All enabled in this account (including filters hidden by search): $1.

sharedNativeRunSelectRows.message: Highlight one or more filter rows to choose what to run. The checkboxes control automatic filtering.

sharedNativeRunNoneEnabled.message: No filters are checked under Run automatically in this account.

sharedNativeRunLocalProgress.message: Running filters on the chosen folder…

sharedNativeRunChecking.message: Checking all linked copies and Inboxes before running filters…

sharedNativeRunPartial.message: Stopped after $1 of $2 folders. The current folder may be partly processed. $3

sharedError_shared_run_unknown_link.message: A selected copy is not linked to a known shared group. Review it in Manage shared filters.

sharedError_shared_run_no_selection.message: Select a linked shared filter to run.

sharedError_shared_run_folder_unavailabl.message: A linked Inbox or the selected folder is unavailable. Check the accounts and try again.

sharedError_shared_run_cancelled.message: The run was stopped. No further accounts will be processed.

sharedError_shared_run_filtering_failed.message: Thunderbird reported a filtering failure. Check the filter log before running it again.

sharedError_shared_run_state_unavailable.message: Shared filter state is unavailable. Open Manage shared filters to check its status.

sharedOrderNewPosition.message: New copy at position $1 of $2. Change the position above to place it before or after other filters.

sharedOrderInvalidPosition.message: Enter a position from 1 to $1 to see where the new copy will go.

sharedChooseAllFolders.message: Choose a destination for every folder action in every selected account.

sharedUnlinkHelp.message: Remove the sharing marker and keep this account’s current rule. The rule continues to run independently.

sharedBeforeHelp.message: The saved conditions below will be replaced along with this rule’s actions and settings.

sharedReadyToSave.message: Preview ready. Review the accounts before saving.

sharedDraftChanged.message: Draft updated. Review changes before saving.

sharedDestinationsCopied.message: Destinations copied. Each selected folder’s account is shown in the preview.

sharedSaved.message: Operation completed. Check each account’s status below; some accounts may need retry or review.

sharedErrorGeneric.message: The operation could not complete. Refresh the account status and try again.

sharedMode_adopt.message: Link and replace an existing filter

sharedMode_detach.message: Stop sharing; keep the current rule

sharedError_account_unavailable.message: This account is unavailable. Its sharing record is preserved.

sharedError_unsupported_account.message: Only independent IMAP and POP accounts can be members.

sharedError_deferred_source.message: This POP account delivers into another account.

sharedError_deferred_destination.message: This account receives deferred POP mail.

sharedError_shared_rules_file.message: Two accounts refer to the same rules file or incoming server.

sharedError_editor_open.message: Close the ordinary Message Filters and Filter Rules windows, then retry.

sharedError_live_disk_conflict.message: Thunderbird has unsaved or conflicting filter changes. Resolve them in Message Filters before retrying.

sharedError_native_drift.message: This account’s filter was edited outside the shared editor. Review which version to keep.

sharedError_missing_replica.message: The linked filter or its marker is missing. Explicitly link a filter, create a replacement, or remove this membership.

sharedError_duplicate_marker.message: More than one filter has this ownership marker. Resolve the duplicate before continuing.

sharedError_malformed_marker.message: A filter has an incomplete sharing marker. Review it before continuing.

sharedError_already_owned.message: That filter already belongs to a shared group.

sharedError_name_collision.message: A different filter has the same name. Link it explicitly or change the shared name.

sharedError_stale_selection.message: The selected filter changed. Refresh and select it again.

sharedError_stale_revision.message: The shared filter changed. Reopen it and try again.

sharedError_stale_preview.message: The account or shared filter changed after preview. Review a fresh preview.

sharedError_preview_expired.message: This preview expired. Review the changes again.

sharedError_unfinished_operation.message: Resolve or retry the unfinished operation before making another edit.

sharedError_folder_unavailable.message: A destination folder is unavailable or cannot receive messages. Select an existing folder.

sharedError_tag_unavailable.message: A tag used by this rule is unavailable. Edit the rule and choose an existing tag.

sharedError_rules_normalization_required.message: Thunderbird must normalize this account’s rules file. Open and save its ordinary Message Filters, then retry.

sharedError_term_unavailable.message: A condition is unavailable for this account and execution setting.

sharedError_custom_header_unavailable.message: A referenced custom message header is not configured in Thunderbird.

sharedError_unsupported_term.message: This rule uses an unsupported custom or database-property condition.

sharedError_unsupported_action.message: This rule contains an action that cannot be shared.

sharedError_condition_round_trip.message: Thunderbird could not copy this rule without changing its conditions.

sharedError_account_identity_changed.message: The account identity changed. Review its membership before continuing.

sharedError_save_failed.message: The filter was not saved. Earlier successful accounts remain updated. Retry when the account is writable.

sharedError_persistence_uncertain.message: The saved result could not be verified. Inspect this account before another write.

sharedError_dependency_changed.message: A folder, tag or condition changed after preview. Review a fresh preview.

sharedError_sender_logic_unsupported.message: Use the shared editor for AND or match-all rules.

sharedError_unknown_schema_version.message: Stored shared-filter data uses an unsupported version. Restore compatible add-on data before making changes.

sharedError_invalid_fields.message: Stored or submitted filter data is incomplete. It has not been reset.

sharedError_missing_state.message: Shared-filter data is missing. Native copies are not automatically adopted.

sharedError_intent_too_large.message: This operation is too large to save safely. Reduce its size or split the accounts into smaller groups.

sharedError_cleanup_required.message: This account is accessible. Stop sharing it so its marker is cleaned up first.

sharedError_repair_changes_definition.message: Unlinking and rule edits must be separate operations.

sharedError_member_removed_without_detac.message: Stop sharing existing members before removing them.

sharedError_mixed_connectors.message: Mixed AND/OR conditions cannot be shared.

sharedError_unsupported_rule.message: This rule cannot be shared without changing its behavior.

sharedError_no_members.message: Select at least one member account.

sharedError_placement_changed.message: The filter order changed. Review a fresh preview.

sharedError_invalid_position.message: Choose a valid position for the new filter.

sharedError_new_member_has_history.message: Refresh the page and select the account again.

sharedUnsupportedBefore.message: This account has an unsupported native edit. Saving explicitly replaces its current conditions, actions and settings with the shared rule shown above.

sharedSelectUnlink.message: Unlink this copy and its duplicates: $1 (position $2)

sharedCleanupHelp.message: These additional linked copies will become independent rules. Their contents and positions stay as shown; only shared ownership is removed.

sharedError_duplicate_cleanup_changed.message: The duplicate copies changed after review. Refresh and select the intended copy again.

sharedError_replica_already_exists.message: A linked copy still exists. Select it explicitly instead of creating another copy.

inboxRunTooltip.message: Run filters on all accounts’ Inboxes

inboxRunEmpty.message: No enabled manual filters to run on any Inbox.

inboxRunStopHelp.message: Finish the current Inbox, then stop before the next account.

inboxRunStopping.message: Stopping after the current Inbox finishes…

inboxRunPartial.message: Finished $2 of $3 Inboxes. $1 Messages already processed remain changed; check the filter log before running again.

inboxRunError_unavailable.message: The filter runner is unavailable. Reload the add-on and try again.

inboxRunError_deferred_account.message: An account uses a shared Global Inbox. Run its filters separately in Message Filters.

inboxRunError_duplicate_inbox.message: Multiple accounts resolve to the same Inbox. Run their filters separately in Message Filters.

inboxRunError_editor_open.message: Close the Filter Rules editor before running filters.

inboxRunError_already_running.message: Filtering is already running in Message Filters. Wait for it to finish.

inboxRunError_inbox_unavailable.message: An account’s Inbox is unavailable. Check the account and try again.

inboxRunError_account_changed.message: An account or Inbox changed during the run. Check the accounts before running again.

inboxRunError_filters_changed.message: The enabled manual filters changed during the run. Review the filters before running again.

inboxRunError_filtering_failed.message: Thunderbird could not finish filtering. Check the account connection and filter log.

inboxReadTooltip.message: Mark all messages in all accounts’ Inboxes as read

inboxReadChecking.message: Preparing to mark all Inboxes read…

inboxReadComplete.message: Marked all messages read in $1 Inbox(es).

inboxReadEmpty.message: No mail account Inboxes are available.

inboxReadPartial.message: Marked $2 of $3 Inboxes read. $1 Messages already processed remain read.

inboxReadError_unavailable.message: The Inbox action is unavailable. Reload the add-on and try again.

inboxReadError_deferred_account.message: An account uses a shared Global Inbox. Mark that Inbox read from its folder menu.

inboxReadError_duplicate_inbox.message: Multiple accounts resolve to the same Inbox. Mark that Inbox read from its folder menu.

inboxReadError_inbox_unavailable.message: An account’s Inbox is unavailable. Check the account and try again.

inboxReadError_account_changed.message: An account or Inbox changed. Check the accounts and try again.

inboxReadError_mark_read_failed.message: Thunderbird could not finish marking messages read. Check the account connection and try again.

sharedError_file_identity_unavailable.message: These accounts have indistinguishable rules-file metadata. Their files must be confirmed independent before sharing.
